files.quality_label: Targeted German cumulative Paper 32 source-author-block/page-break repair candidate
files.coverage: Noether/Brauer Paper 32, `Über minimale Zerfällungskörper irreduzibler Darstellungen`, `Sitzungsberichte der Preussischen Akademie der Wissenschaften` 1927, printed pp.221-228. The package applies a narrow RA73-to-RA74 German cumulative TeX repair: inserts a clear page before Paper 32, restores the source author block `Von Privatdozent Dr. Richard Brauer` / `in Königsberg` / `und Prof. Dr. Emmy Noether` / `in Göttingen.`, and keeps the existing Schur presentation note below the restored author block. It includes the RA74 German cumulative TeX/PDF/log, RA73-to-RA74 diff, IA/scandata source mapping, extracted JP2/JPG source leaves for printed pp.221-228, a JP2-derived article source PDF, labelled 1200dpi inspection crops for the title/author/Schur note and footnote, audit/provenance CSVs, method note, README, and checksums.
files.findings: The package README reports XeLaTeX pass 1 and pass 2 success, rendered cumulative PDF output, and text QA confirming the restored author block and that Paper 32 starts on a new rendered page. The package states that the Paper 32 footnote reset already existed in RA73 and was not duplicated. No Paper 32 mathematical body text was changed.
files.limitations: Targeted source-apparatus/front-matter repair candidate only. It does not certify the Paper 32 mathematical body, does not certify every formula or prose line, does not promote a unified German branch, and does not propagate to English, Spanish, Japanese, French, Chinese, Ukrainian, Russian, or Interslavic branches. It is not a critical edition. The separate compact IA source-witness package remains provenance support; source images control readings and OCR is only a locator aid.
